title: Craftland Mobile block recipe index from the Game Mechanics template manual

source.source_quality: Public translated tutorial corpus containing many screenshots and links to Garena CDN; no explicit license field surfaced; use as a reference and do not copy whole article.

recipes.title: Healing area
recipes.goal: Continuously restore player health and show a healing effect
recipes.caveat: The source is a translated template explanation; inspect its linked screenshots/source template for the exact connected block sequence.

recipes.title: Damage zone
recipes.caveat: Treat this as an example recipe; confirm current block sockets and event names in the current editor.

recipes.title: Monster spawn zone
recipes.goal: Spawn a zombie near the zone and play a sound effect
mechanics: Set zombie type / target behaviour / path
recipes.caveat: Labels for Behaviour/Behavior and type dropdown contents may vary by locale/version.

recipes.title: Trap area
recipes.goal: Drop a cage to trap a player, show a countdown, then reset the trap
recipes.caveat: The source section is long and the visual example should be read together with its screenshots before generating exact node wiring.

recipes.title: Transfer area
recipes.trigger: Player enters a custom trigger; can cancel the transfer while the countdown/effect is active
recipes.goal: Teleport a player to a destination after a countdown while showing/hiding text and effects
mechanics: Create/hide UI text and visual effects
recipes.caveat: Exact target position, timers, and event signatures depend on the specific sample; retain the source links for visual verification.

recipes.title: Text display area
recipes.goal: Show HelloWorld text while inside and hide it when the player leaves
recipes.caveat: Text entity creation and visibility behavior must be checked against current Mobile block labels.

recipes.title: Outfit change area
recipes.goal: Change player outfit according to gender
recipes.caveat: Outfit IDs are dynamic asset selectors; do not assume every available ID is in a fixed enum.

recipes.title: Elevator
recipes.goal: Move elevator up while occupied and down when empty
recipes.caveat: The manual example describes a step-loop implementation, not necessarily a native elevator API.

recipes.title: Automatic door
recipes.trigger: Player enters/leaves the door's trigger range
recipes.goal: Open door on approach, close it when player leaves
recipes.caveat: The screenshots/template define the actual open/close transform and block sequence.

recipes.title: Global script for shared state
recipes.goal: Initialize a shared variable for tracking mechanism/device states
recipes.caveat: The same variable is referenced by elevator and button-door examples; use Global scope only when cross-entity sharing is intended.

recipes.title: Player script for respawn
recipes.goal: Reset player-specific state and respawn after a short delay
recipes.caveat: Exact event labels and respawn API names must be cross-checked against current docs; this index records what the tutorial describes.

recipes.title: HUD button controlling a door/state
recipes.trigger: Player clicks a custom HUD button
recipes.goal: Perform different actions based on the door's current state and shared marker
mechanics: Read entity property and global variable
recipes.caveat: The source illustrates an interactive button workflow, not a complete general-purpose UI API listing.

recipes.title: Respawn point active-window script
recipes.goal: Enable respawn point briefly then deactivate it
recipes.caveat: Validate event availability and active-property behavior in the target mode/editor.
